messages:
people-ops: Quick drop — new micro-kit for promotion-focused goal conversations. Short, copy-pasteable scripts + a small scoring checklist. Use in 1:1s or calibration chats. :rocket:

people-ops: 1) Senior IC goal script (30-60s):
```
Manager: "Tell me the top outcome you want to own this cycle. What signals would show it's progressing?"
IC: "Own X feature: reduce end-to-end latency by 20% (p95), mentor 2 teammates, and own rollout runbook."
Manager: "Great — we'll sync monthly, I'll pair you with Y for architecture reviews, and we'll set a canary for the rollout."
```

people-ops: 2) Manager-track (promotion readiness) script:
```
Manager: "Which cross-team outcomes have you influenced this year? Where did you move strategy or resolve ambiguity?"
IC: "Led cross-org cache project: aligned infra + product, cut costs 18%, documented decision tradeoffs."
Manager: "Let's capture artifacts (design, PRs, metrics) and set a 3-month stretch owning onboarding for X team."
```

people-ops: 3) Stretch-project alignment (short template):
```
Manager: "What's the smallest measurable step that will show this project is viable in 6 weeks?"
IC: "Ship a gated experiment that proves 10% engagement lift; if green, scale to beta."
Manager: "Good — we'll block 2 sprints and reserve one cross-team sync slot."
```

people-ops: Quick scoring checklist (use in notes):
- Scope clarity: 1-3 (how focused is the goal)
- Measurability: 1-3 (clear metric / artifact)
- Impact alignment: 1-3 (ties to team/org outcomes)
- Leadership signals: 1-3 (mentorship, cross-team influence)

alex_k: Love this. Can we add timing guidance? e.g., cadence for check-ins and a suggested review artifact list.

people-ops: Yep — suggested cadence: 2-week tactical check-ins + monthly calibration review. Artifacts: PR links, dashboard panel, one-line decision log.

michelle: Tiny ask — can we include 2 example metrics per role? managers often want concrete numbers.

people-ops: On it. Example metrics to paste under each script: Senior IC: p95 latency (ms) and percent CPU saved; Manager-track: cross-team delivery % on-time and customer satisfaction delta.

sam: Can you drop this into the 1:1 template and give a short blurb for managers to copy into Slack threads when starting promotion conversations?

people-ops: Will do. Short blurb for Slack: "Heads-up: starting promotion-readiness check-ins this month — see micro-kit attached. Bring 1-2 artifacts and a one-line outcome." :thumbsup: I'll push the kit to Confluence and ping here with the link.

people-bot: note: confluence page created — /people-ops/promo-microkit (private to org).

alex_k: Thanks — will use in my next 1:1s.

michelle: Thanks! saving copy. :sparkles:"
